about: The parts of the terminal plugin's texts that thimble browser uses (server/thimble_browser/prompts.py). Each part is a file under prompts/terminal/, a section of it and, when given, some of its bullets (counted from 1). `replace` and `drop` are the only changes, exact strings; tests/test_prompt_parity.py fails when the terminal's text no longer holds one of them.

citing.heading: Citing
replace: run `thimble rows` on its ref before you use it
read its ref with `read_ref` before you use it
drop: `thimble coverage` lists the files this session read or computed over, and those it only searched, only named or counted, or never touched: none of these were read.

replace: (the squeezed text, when they read it squeezed)
; and an optional "program" of at most six lines on thimble's drawing toolkit, only when a tiny drawing says it better than words.
. thimble browser draws no "program", so give none.
